input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser splits the file on "\n" only, so files with Windows-style CRLF line endings (as produced by the new accounting export tool) leave a trailing "\r" on the last column of the header line (e.g. "description\r"). That makes `assertShape` think a required column is missing on the header row itself (index 0), which is why every upload fails immediately with "Malformed row" on row 1, even though the column structure is otherwise unchanged. The parser needs to normalize/strip "\r" when splitting lines (or split on /\r?\n/) before processing the header and rows.
